NEW SECTION . 533C.1004 Wire transmission fees. 7 1. For purposes of this section, “wire transmission” means 8 money transmission by wire to or from locations abroad. 9 2. In addition to any other fee required by law for a wire 10 transmission, a licensee or the licensee’s authorized delegate 11 shall collect from a customer a fee of five dollars for each 12 wire transmission equal to or less than five hundred dollars, 13 and in addition to such fee, if applicable, an amount equal to 14 two percent of the amount of the wire transmission in excess 15 of five hundred dollars. 16 3. The fees collected under subsection 2 shall be remitted 17 quarterly by the licensee or the licensee’s authorized 18 delegate to the department of revenue in the form and manner 19 prescribed by the department of revenue, in consultation with 20 the department of public safety. All required forms and 21 remittances shall be filed with the department of revenue no 22 later than the fifteenth day of the month following the close 23 of each calendar quarter. 24 4. The department of revenue shall account for all fees 25 remitted under subsection 3 and pay ninety percent of the 26 same to the office to combat human trafficking established in 27 section 80.45, and deposit the remaining ten percent in the 28 general fund of the state. 29 5. a. The department of revenue, in consultation with the 30 department of public safety, shall enforce the provisions of 31 this section. 32 b. If a licensee or licensee’s authorized delegate fails 33 to comply with subsection 3, the department of revenue shall 34 notify the superintendent who may suspend or revoke the 35 -1- H 8333.3929 (1) 91 nls/ko 1/ 2 #1. licensee’s license under section 533C.901, and may issue an 1 order suspending or revoking the designation of an authorized 2 delegate under section 533C.902.
